text.en: Clients frequently commend team members such as Angie, Cheyanne, and Chris for their welcoming demeanor and practical expertise. Pet owners appreciate that staff take the time to explain equipment, demonstrate gym apparatus, and assist during bathing sessions. Reviewers note that personnel treat dogs and visitors with genuine hospitality and warmth.

title.en: Clean facility and canine gym amenities

text.en: Reviewers praise the shop for its tidy, climate-controlled layout and modern fitness equipment designed specifically for dogs. Pet owners appreciate having self-service wash bays equipped with drying apparatus and quality shampoos during hot Phoenix days. Clients describe the environment as relaxing, well ventilated, and thoughtfully structured for pet recreation.

Dog parents highlight how comfortable their dogs feel during visits, including energetic huskies and pets prone to anxiety during nail trims or baths. Reviewers observe that staff use a calm, patient approach that helps dogs settle quickly. Several clients note that their animals adapted comfortably to manual treadmill workouts under staff guidance.

q.en: Does Paws 48 provide self-service dog wash stations?

a.en: Yes, pet owners can utilise self-service washing bays equipped with specialty shampoos, wash tubs, and blow dryers.

q.en: Are canine treadmill and gym workouts available?

a.en: Yes, the facility offers specialized manual and powered dog treadmills with staff guidance on proper canine fitness.

q.en: Can dogs receive professional grooming services on-site?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that full grooming sessions, bathing packages, and nail trims are provided by salon staff.

q.en: Is advance booking required for visits?

a.en: Online booking is supported through their web platform, and subscription packages are offered for recurring visitors.
